summary_1line: Rama walks to the Sarayu, enters the river, and is welcomed by Brahma and the gods as he returns to his true form as Vishnu.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands in the Sarayu River as flowers rain from the sky and gods in radiant aerial chariots fill the glowing heavens above him.
Brahma seated in a luminous celestial chariot addresses Rama from the sky while Gandharvas and Apsaras sing and play instruments in the air.
Rama with his brothers steps into the shimmering river as the gathered gods watch him return to his divine form as Vishnu.
